findings.statement: The adapter's emitted PRISMA source descriptor classifies NTRS as prisma_category=online_resource, while the tracked SLR1 source/interface crosswalk requires NTRS in prisma_2020_column=databases_registers and describes it as a technical-report database.
findings.impact: A future adapter artifact would misclassify the required NTRS discovery event in review reporting.

findings.statement: The adapter exposes only integer --year-start/--year-end controls and constructs YYYY-01-01/YYYY-12-31 bounds, so it cannot express an arbitrary exact P-001 upper date. Its bounded loop has no strict final-run mode that performs two complete ordered stable-ID passes or rejects missing/duplicate IDs.
findings.impact: The current route cannot by itself implement the protocol-required exact-date, stable-identity, duplicate, ordering, and two-pass completeness controls for a final event.

required_stop.statement: The demonstrated code issue was preserved without a patch. Per the pilot contract, affected live NTRS querying stopped after this assessment; no retry or second pilot was started.

smallest_separately_scoped_fix.recommendation: Create one NTRS adapter corrective change, separately reviewed and committed before a newly authorized pilot: correct NTRS PRISMA classification; add exact ISO --date-start/--date-end transport; and add --require-complete that fixes/records validated sort, exhausts pages, checks nonempty unique NTRS IDs, and compares two full ordered ID passes. Add tests for all four behaviors.
smallest_separately_scoped_fix.why_not_patch_here: This subagent is assigned a diagnostic pilot only and may not patch external/shared code.
